title: View of Wimmis by F.E. Church
content: Frederic Edwin Church had the ability, even in a small field study, to capture a lot of convincing detail and texture, working quickly over a pencil line drawing in a single pass of oil paint.View of Wimmis, Valley of the Simmental, Switzerland by Frederic Church, 1868, oil on paper mounted on canvas 32.4 x 50.5 cmThe original is only about 13 inches tall, so, depending on the size of your monitor, this detail may be about actual size.
